claim_scope: Optimal ordinary zero-forcing seed sets of labelled path powers for \(k\ge2\), \(n\ge k+2\), and cycle powers for \(k\ge2\), \(n\ge2k+3\); exact counts and natural symmetry orbits.
integrity: Proved by an elementary first-step, propagation and cyclic-intersection argument; finite exhaustive verifier is corroboration only. No external or independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Minimum cardinalities and dense/degree-one boundaries are existing mathematics. The theorem does not enumerate all sizes, all graph powers, or forcing sequences. Historical priority beyond inspected sources remains open.
title: Exact optimal zero-forcing seed classifications for powers of paths and cycles
